summary: Itau Unibanco filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, submitting an updated version of its annual Reference Form (2025, v3) to the SEC under Rule 13a-16. The filing is a routine foreign issuer report containing standard corporate information, management commentary, guidance, risk factors, and governance disclosures. It reflects resubmissions to update items 3.1, 3.2, and 7.3 as of August 4, 2026, but includes no transaction, special event, or shareholder action. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic processes are mentioned. This is an ordinary regulatory disclosure with no special-situation characteristics.
